operationScope: These are API operation names for concrete normal-owner plans, not an attachable IAM policy or completeness/effectiveness claim. Bucket/object ARN and function names fixed above; distribution/OAC/header IDs and ETags must be captured from that owner. Creation APIs have no prior generated ARN; no blanket CloudFront or bucket adoption/deletion is approved. Missing provider read or denied operation stops for exact review; do not expand silently.
reversal: Observe optional API removal and deployed static 503 before EKS retirement. Host withdrawal: disable distribution, observe deployed-disabled, inventory all owned object versions/markers/uploads, review exact IDs, remove them, then normal owner destroy ten static resources (or twelve if API controls still present). Preserve state/receipts externally. No force_destroy, blind purge, shared resource deletion or guaranteed future approval.
